$comment: Decision log strings (O6.6.1; N3). Every user-facing string comes from here by id with named slots. Content keys (decision types, option labels, sources) are resolved by the host's text lookup.

strings.dl.title: Decision log
strings.dl.filter.wrong: Only choices the model called clearly wrong
strings.dl.summary: {shown} of {total} decisions · clearly right {right} · toss-up {toss} · clearly wrong {wrong} · win chance given up {cost} · model not run yet {pending}
strings.dl.model.title: The model's view at the time
strings.dl.model.pending: The model's view is not in yet.
strings.dl.model.lacks: The model does not account for: {list}
strings.dl.model.call: Expected points over the scouted mix {foresight} (from {n} plays) · how predictable the call was {pred}
strings.dl.model.followUp: No score for this kind of decision. Follow-up checks due: {dates}
strings.dl.model.followUpDone: Check of {date}: {people} people, bands at the time overlapped: {overlap}
strings.dl.superseded: Replaced before it took effect by {ids}
